def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for j in range(w):
        nz=[(i,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) if g[i][j]!=0]
        for i in range(h):
            if g[i][j]!=0: continue
            below=[v for ii,v in nz if ii>i]
            above=[v for ii,v in nz if ii<i]
            if below: out[i][j]=below[0]
            elif above: out[i][j]=above[-1]
    return out
